text: Original text cropped at maximum cached consumed-Qwen-token character end; no Qwen activation features.
pooled: Last-layer masked mean including CLS/SEP and normalized CLS; no query instruction on document texts.
token: Character-overlap weighted independent last-layer features; L2, masked-mean fallback; each measured document weight one.
split: The original research document/group split and identical random labeled order; no product split substitution.
ridge_cv: Three training-group folds; alphas [0.1, 1, 10, 100]; document-mean MAE; all transformations training-only.
primary_gp: Validation macro-domain absolute theta error at epsilon 0.05 compared with mini_mean_gp.
primary_token: Validation document-mean MAE compared with mini_token_ridge.
uncertainty: Ridge means only: no fabricated sigma/CDF/aggregate posterior for token models.
limitations: These research test pools have already been inspected.
Seeds measure algorithmic variation, not new independent datasets.
BGE recommendation does not prove superiority for JSD prediction.
Max length 256 isolates model/pooling at the previous cap; does not test the encoder's full 512-token capacity.
Fixed-label predictor study; acquisition/live-product changes require another verified check.
